title: Edmund and the Horizon
author: Elodie Zhou
blurb: Rosalind Whitlock, a starship navigator haunted by the backups sleeping in the hold, maintains the beacon nobody remembers commissioning. Then a distress signal arrives in a language extinct for two centuries — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must decide which half of humanity wakes from cryosleep before the fleet's truce expires.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
